sections.title: P10.8 pre-move inventory (2026-09-24)
sections.text:
- `packages/attributes/src` contains 59 PHP files: Profile B under `structure-profiles.md` (40–100).
- Production imports of `CoreX\Attributes\Internal\*` outside `packages/attributes/`: zero (`rg` over `packages/*` PHP source).
- Public `Contracts/`, `Data/`, `Exceptions/`, `Support/` and `AttributesServiceProvider` stay at their current paths and FQCNs.
- Move map: `Engine/{EavAttributeStore,JsonbAttributeStore,FieldValueValidator,AttributeWriteGuard}` → `Internal/Values`; `Engine/{QueuedSchemaOperations,SchemaOperationWorker}` and `Registry/*` → `Internal/Schema`; `Engine/ScopeConnectionGuard` → `Internal/Storage`; `Engine/StructuralAttributeFilter` and `Schema/{AttributeIndexPlanner,AttributeIndexReceipt}` → `Internal/Query`; `Schema/{AttributeBackfill,AttributeValueTransformerRegistry}` → `Internal/Values`. Existing `Internal/Integration`, `Internal/Laravel`, `Internal/Storage`, and remaining `Internal/Schema` keep their subsystem paths. Internal FQCNs change with these moves.
- Compatibility baseline: package `composer.json` declares only `Contracts`, `Data`, `Exceptions` as public API roots; no planned public signature or config-key edits. Post-move comparison and gate evidence follow below.

sections.title: P10.8 final layout and compatibility
sections.text:
`RAG:—` The final census is **62 PHP files** in `packages/attributes/src`, within Profile B (40–100). Six private subsystems are top-level physical directories; their `CoreX\Attributes\Internal\*` namespaces remain private. Composer classmaps those directories. Production optimized autoload passes `composer dump-autoload -o --strict-psr --no-dev --no-scripts`. The dev strict check reports five test helper classes declared inside test files; the production check is the applicable autoload proof.

| Directory | PHP files | Owner |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `src/Schema` | 9 | catalogues, revisions, lifecycle and queued operations |
| `src/Values` | 6 | JSONB/EAV stores, validation, write guard and backfill |
| `src/Query` | 3 | structural filter and measured index planner |
| `src/Storage` | 3 | tenant connection guard and entity store resolver |
| `src/Integration` | 4 | metadata event, translator and public-port registry adapter |
| `src/Laravel` | 3 | validated composition and message registrars |

Named use-case spans for P16.11: definition lookup = Schema + Storage; value write = Values + Storage; entity store selection = Storage + Values; message publication = Values + Integration; index planning = Query + Storage. The `Internal` namespace retains the R2 private boundary. `RegistryFieldCatalogue` keeps its name for P15.

`RAG:—` The Roave comparison (`BC_CHECK_ONLY=attributes bash scripts/bc-check.sh`) reports eight removals, all former `Internal\Engine` or `Internal\Registry` FQCNs. It reports **no removed or changed public symbol**. `extra.corex.public-api` remains exactly `Contracts`, `Data`, `Exceptions`; these directories retain their paths and FQCNs. The package is experimental, so the wrapper returns 0 with an explicit internal `bc-break` report. `composer.lock` was refreshed for path-repository autoload metadata.

sections.title: P10.8 architecture and ownership ratchets
sections.text:
- `scripts/attributes-architecture-gate.php` checks the Profile-B census and physical directories, namespace/path agreement, unchanged public roots, zero `CoreX\Search` references and attribute-owned DDL targets. It invokes the existing package graph, config composition and table ownership scanners. The package exposes it as `architecture:check` and runs it from its test suite.
- Four planted fixtures under `tests/fixtures/attributes-architecture` each exit 1 for their own reason: A1 search import, A2 runtime `config()`, A3 foreign DDL on `users`, A4 field-level engine selection. The normal tree exits 0. `AttributeComposition` now rejects a field-level engine before the catalogue binds.
- The provider's messaging binding uses an attributes-owned adapter of the public `MessageContractRegistry` port; the foreign core `Internal` import is gone. Two Laravel registrars leave the provider at five counted bindings under its six-binding ratchet. The graph allowlist follows moved exact paths; two exact `RecordRef`/`WriteToken` edges have named expiry until the core public surface is addressed.
- `docs/architecture/table-ownership.md` records the three P10.3-owned tenant tables: `sys_attribute_definitions`, `sys_attribute_key_reservations`, `sys_attribute_backfills`. D119 is the accepted G-DDL grant for their additive migration; P10.8 adds no DDL.

sections.title: P10.8 final recipe evidence
sections.text:
| §12 step | Evidence |
|:--|:--|
| 1. Isolated DB | Docker `corex_pgsql_test` healthy; host `pg_isready` accepted `127.0.0.1:5434`; `corex_test` exists and passes the `_test` guard in `PgTestCase`. |
| 2. Both lanes | Package SQLite 65 tests/204 assertions and PG 42/228; root SQLite 494/1654 and PG 210/879. Root PHPStan 0 errors; root Pint passed. |
| 3. No modules | `AttributesServiceProviderTest` resolves static catalogue without module bindings; `DatabaseFieldCatalogueTest` reads the tenant DB through its own connection guard. |
| 4. Conflicts/cache | `CompositeFieldCatalogueTest` covers four distinct rejections, byte-identical merge, exact retirement shadow, cache corruption, source fingerprint invalidation and source fallback. |
| 5–6. Evolution/rollback | `DefinitionEvolutionTest`, `AttributeEvolutionTest`, `AttributeBackfillTest` cover rename/type transitions, both engines' dual read/write, rollback before and after switch, interrupted batch restart, concurrent write/drift, no early drop. |
| 7–8. Resolver/index | `AttributeStoreResolverTest` rejects per-field/mixed maps and preserves `loadMany` order; `AttributeIndexTest` rejects dirty casts, verifies expression B-tree and stable record-id tie order, and keeps promoted storage free of foreign DDL. |
| 9. Eight write checks | `AttributeWriteGuardTest` distinguishes existence, schema, subject, view, write, mutate, type and constraints; `AttributeWriteAuthorizationTest` proves atomic denial on JSONB and EAV. |
| 10. Outbox privacy | `AttributeOutboxTest` proves one mutation/one metadata-only outbox row, no replay row and rollback on admission refusal; `AttributeMessageTranslatorTest` asserts no values in payload. |
| 11. Ratchets | `composer --working-dir=packages/attributes architecture:check`, `composer test:arch` (54 tests/175 assertions), four negative fixtures and `php scripts/table-ownership-gate.php` pass. |
| 12. Public snapshot | Roave reports only the eight private FQCN removals; public roots and FQCNs remain, with no public removal/change reported. |

P11 receives the authoritative composite catalogue, reversible migration evidence and metadata-only outbox. P16.11 consumes the 62-file Profile-B census and named use-case spans above.
